overview: The step-200,000 checkpoint together with the runtime it needs: model.pth, config.json, symbols.json, the phoneme frontend and the VITS inference runtime. This is the `model/` directory of the repository, unchanged, so `model/checksums.sha256` still verifies.
usage:
Upload this instance, then in a notebook:

    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, '/kaggle/input/azerbaijani-tts/pytorch/pytorch-fp32/1')
    from aztts import AzTTS
    tts = AzTTS('/kaggle/input/azerbaijani-tts/pytorch/pytorch-fp32/1/model')
    tts.save('Salam, necəsiniz?', '/kaggle/working/salam.wav')

The model runs on CPU at 2-4x real time and needs no network access at inference time.
